title: Sandy Paws Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: NatureWalk 'Sandy Paws' is a 3 bedroom + bunk room, fire pit, pet friendly, golf cart, bikes
description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of NatureWalk at Seagrove in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, "Sandy Paws" offers timeless coastal elegance in one of the most coveted communities along Scenic Highway 30A! HOME HI-LIGHTS: ✦Outdoor Living at its finest! Multiple outside, comfortable covered decks spaces with swings, couches, TV and more! ✦Outdoor Firepit with 6 Adirondack chairs ✦Golf Cart Available with additional refundable security deposit ✦5 Adult Bikes included! ✦Dog Friendly! With fenced in yard! ✦Fully stocked kitchen ✦Community biking paths for easy beach access! ✦Community zero-entry pool, covered baby pool and lap swimming pool- 3 min walk from the home! ✦6 Beach Chairs and 2 Umbrellas ✦Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → Use of owner's golf cart with a signed liability waiver and a $1500 refundable security deposit → Pet Fee → One, preferably non-shedding small dog allowed for $300 → Vacation Cancellation Protection → Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Floor 1: ▪️QUEEN Bedroom with En-Suite full bath (tub/shower combo), TV Garage Living Room Kitchen/Dining Screened in back porch offering a swing and large couch Floor 2: ▪️KING Primary Suite with En-Suite bath, separate tub and shower, TV and direct access to outdoor, secluded porch with multiple seating options ▪️QUEEN bedroom with En-suite bath (tub/shower combo), TV ▪️DUAL TWIN BUNK nook located off loft area, sleeps 4 Loft area with TV and couch Climb the porch steps to the shaded retreat,... a welcoming spot to sip iced tea and watch the world drift by in peaceful tranquility. The sizable, bespoke residence opens with a grand two-story foyer that leads to a guest suite and full bath before flowing into a spacious open family room boasting gleaming hardwood floors. The living area offers ample space for socializing and relaxing beneath a dramatic dark beamed ceiling, centered on an imposing fireplace flanked by exquisite craftsman-built cabinetry. The kitchen is a true chef's dream, highlighted by a huge granite-topped island with an integrated double sink providing generous room for cooking, casual breakfasts perched on stools while chatting with the cook, and effortlessly serving drinks and nibbles during lively entertaining. A separate dining nook creates a gracious setting for formal meals, framed by serene views of the surroundings. Upstairs, desirable features abound, including two sets of built-in bunks with an adjoining sitting area perfect for family or guests, plus an elegant master suite that opens to a huge second-floor porch ideal for savoring morning coffee while overlooking the breathtaking landscape. The luxurious marble ensuite spa bath indulges with a soothing corner tub and separate walk-in shower. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, backing directly onto a nature preserve where plenty of space remains to add a pool if desired. The elevated deck beckons for sunset views and casual barbecues, while the pavered terrace is designed for magical evenings stargazing, toasting marshmallows around the fire pit, and forging unforgettable memories under the stars. NatureWalk at Seagrove's premier amenities, including a serene nature pond and the private, gated Gathering Place, a true resort-style oasis featuring a refreshing zero-entry (beach-entry) pool, a seasonally heated lap pool for invigorating swims, a fun kiddie splash pool, a relaxing hot tub, cozy fire pit gatherings, gas grills for impromptu BBQs, lounge chairs, hammocks, shaded patios with tables and chairs, restrooms, showers, a kitchenette, and even resident mailboxes. Additional community highlights include a children's playground, fitness stations, multi-purpose sports courts (like pickleball), pet-friendly trails, and miles of traffic-free paths. Whether you're craving peaceful forest mornings, action-packed pool and beach days, invigorating trail adventures, or relaxed evenings with loved ones, this outstanding property promises rejuvenation, adventure, and lifelong 30A magic. Your slice of paradise is calling you. Welcome home! ✦ FREE WIFI ✦ At least 1 must guest must be 25 years of age to rent ✦ No parties

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
